name: Cubic Defense
desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Negate that attack, then you can Special Summon up to 2 "Cubic" monsters from your hand and/or Deck, ignoring their Summoning conditions. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Cubic" card you control; this turn, negate any card or effect activated by your opponent that targeted that card.
